responsibility: Implements GCC’s AddressSanitizer and Hardware-assisted AddressSanitizer instrumentation on GIMPLE/RTL, adding memory-access checks, stack/global poisoning, alloca and use-after-scope protection, shadow-memory handling, and translation of internal sanitizer functions into runtime calls or inline checks. It also owns sanitizer module initialization for ASan/HWASan, target-sensitive HWASan stack tagging support, and helper logic that decides how accesses are checked, how stack frames are laid out and poisoned/unpoisoned, and how sanitizer-specific builtins are materialized for later expansion and code generation.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the ASan/HWASan sanitizer machinery: it contains the actual GIMPLE/RTL passes, runtime-call lowering, stack poisoning/tagging logic, and file-finalization code. Unlike gcc/asan.h, it does the instrumentation work rather than just declaring shared interfaces, constants, and policy helpers used by other sanitizer code.
